name: AI-HQ
description: T3 Chat Clone for Theo's Cloneathon

paragraphs: A full-stack AI chat platform built with Next.js 15, focused on power-user productivity and deep integration across software design/engineering workflows (with room to branch into other fields). Ships with app-hosted models served through the FuelIX gateway (Gemini, Claude, GPT and more), plus a generic bring-your-own-key (BYOK) connector for any OpenAI-compatible provider. Supports streaming responses, per-chat model switching, media attachments, and full access with no account required.
features: FuelIX Gateway - Every usable model on the FuelIX API is available in the model picker, fetched live from /models
Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) - Connect any OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenAI, Anthropic-compatible gateways, OpenRouter, Together AI, self-hosted, etc.) with your own API key, encrypted at rest
Dynamic Model Switching - Change AI models mid-conversation with context preservation
Streaming Responses - Real-time AI response streaming with typing indicators
Context Preservation - Intelligent conversation history management

requirements.text: Supports streaming responses, per-chat model switching, media attachments, and full access with no account required.
Open the app and start chatting immediately — no account required, every feature unlocked.
Chats and API keys are saved under an anonymous browser cookie; signing in (email/password or GitHub) is optional and keeps them on your account instead.
Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) - Connect any OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenAI, Anthropic-compatible gateways, OpenRouter, Together AI, self-hosted, etc.) with your own API key, encrypted at rest
At minimum you need MONGODBURI, NEXTAUTHSECRET, NEXTAUTHURL, and one AI provider key.
